text:
maria: Quick coordination — target cutoff for v1.9.0 is TOMORROW 18:00 UTC. Need final confirms for: version bump, changelog, security sign-off, docs checklist, and smoke QA. Please reply with owners.

kevin: I can take the version bump. PR 1286 opened, waiting on CI. `npm version minor && git push --tags` in the PR description.

release-bot: CI status for PR 1286: ✅ all checks passed (unit, lint). Docker build queued.

jordan: I drafted the changelog entry in PR 1290 — notes about batching improvements and a small CLI flag change. Need a quick wording review.

maria: @jordan drop the changelog snippet here so @docs can copy. Also confirm migration note?

jordan: changelog snippet: "Improve serving throughput by ~12% via batching window tuning. Added --batch-window flag to runtime CLI for fine tuning." No migration required, just opt-in tuning.

frida: Security review: ran local Snyk and a dependency scan. One low-severity transitive flagged (http-parser) — remediation planned but not blocking. Filed ticket SEC-452.

maria: Frida, please add a short note in the release notes about the dependency and link SEC-452, so CS has context if customers ask.

tara-qa: QA plan: smoke window tomorrow 17:00–17:30 UTC. I need a deploy point and a quick rollback plan. Can someone own the smoke deploy?

kevin: I can own deploy and rollback plan. Deploy steps are in ops/runbooks/release-smoke.md. Rollback is the tag revert + redeploy of previous tag. Will post exact commands in a sec.

kevin: Deploy snippet:```bash
# tag and push
git tag -a v1.9.0 -m "v1.9.0"
git push origin v1.9.0
# trigger release pipeline
./deploy/release.sh --tag v1.9.0 --env staging
```

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: cutoff in 22 hours. To mute reminders react with :no_bell:.

maria: Action items summary: 
- Version bump: @kevin (PR 1286) ✅ CI passed
- Changelog: @jordan (PR 1290) — please paste final snippet into PR
- Security: @frida — SEC-452 filed, low severity, note in release notes
- QA smoke: @tara-qa — window 17:00 UTC, @kevin will own deploy/rollback
- Docs: unassigned — asking @docs for a quick spotcheck of the changelog wording

frida: I'll add the SEC-452 link to the release notes in PR 1290 now.

maria: If anyone is blocking, flag here ASAP. Otherwise we'll cut at 18:00 UTC and do canary + smoke. :thumbsup:

tara-qa: not blocked, will prep checklist and allocate 2 engineers for smoke.

jordan: updated PR with the final snippet and added a docs pointer.

kevin: tagging the release candidate once we hit cutoff. I'll post a follow-up 30m before.

maria: Thanks all — small final favor: if you won't be online at cutoff, reply with your replacement.

kevin: party in calendar for deploy and smoke.

maria: great, moving to green light unless objections.

release-bot: Cutoff reminder will post again in 30 minutes.
